name: cloud-flows
title_zh: Dataverse 云流的草稿、发布、回滚
tagline_zh: 在 Power Automate 里改流像改代码一样安全：先存草稿再发布，出问题一键回滚旧版本。
tagline_en: Edit Power Automate flows like code: save drafts, publish safely, restore old versions, and inspect action.
desc_en: Work with Power Automate solution-aware Cloud Flows on Dataverse — inspect, save draft, publish, restore versions, trigger runs, debug action outputs, and patch FetchXML / action inputs surgically. Includes a compact iteration workflow for safe edit-test-publish cycles, and FetchXML guidance (rollup trade-offs, comment pitfalls, aggregate limits) for classification flows. Use when the user asks ab
why_zh: 它把「编辑-测试-发布」收成紧凑闭环，FetchXML 修补按字段级下刀。
why_en: It closes the edit-test-publish loop with surgical FetchXML/action patching and flags aggregate limits and comment pitfalls.
limit_zh: 只认 Dataverse 解决方案感知的 Cloud Flows；非 Dataverse 数据源或经典流不支持。
limit_en: Only solution-aware Cloud Flows on Dataverse; no classic flows or non-Dataverse connectors. Debugging stops at action outputs. Requires Power.
title_en: Draft, publish, rollback, and debug Dataverse cloud flows
